newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens lower tracking Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens lower tracking Wall Street.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index of leading UK shares fell at the opening, after a sharp decline on Wall Street triggered selling on equity markets worldwide.
Fears the Federal Reserve will soon raise U.S. interest rates were reignited after a set of stronger-than-expected U.S. economic data released yesterday.
By 0737 GMT, the FTSE 100 was down 18.5 points at 3,866.5, with losers broadly outpacing advancers by a margin of more than eight to one.
September FTSE futures, meanwhile, were off 14.0 points at 3,880 and September gilt futures were 6/32 lower at 107-4/32.
